title: Federal Skilled Worker Program: six selection factors

professional: Professional degree needed to practise a licensed profession
two-or-more: Two or more credentials, one of them 3+ years

spouse_language: Spouse or partner at CLB 4 or higher in all four abilities
study_canada: You: 2+ academic years of full-time study in Canada (program of 2+ years)
spouse_study_canada: Spouse or partner: past full-time study in Canada
work_canada: You: 1+ year full-time skilled (TEER 0-3) work in Canada with authorization
spouse_work_canada: Spouse or partner: 1+ year full-time work in Canada with authorization
relative_canada: Relative in Canada (18+, citizen or PR): parent, grandparent, child, grandchild, sibling, aunt, uncle, niece, nephew

notes: From 2026-11-03 a job offer needs no LMIA to qualify (officer still assesses genuineness).
Job offer: 1+ year, one employer, continuous, paid, full-time (30+ h/week), not seasonal, TEER 0-3.
Minimum experience: 1 year continuous full-time (or 1,560 hours) in one NOC, TEER 0-3, within the last 10 years.
Proof of funds not needed if authorized to work in Canada with a valid job offer (or for CEC).
